title: Intrinsic proper/open mates and pasting for varying coefficient systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be any inverse sequence of commutative rings, and put $B_{n,T}=(C_n)_T$ on a fixed small skeleton of the pro-etale site of every scheme $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathscr S_T$ be the category of strict semilinear module systems: an object consists of $B_{n,T}$-module sheaves $M_n$ and $B_{n+1,T}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$; morphisms commute with transitions. Use $D(\mathscr S_T)$ and its simultaneous section models [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For a scheme map $v$, let $P_v$ be exact termwise inverse image and $S_v$ total derived direct image, with $P_v\dashv S_v$, unit $\eta_v$ and counit $\varepsilon_v$. For an open immersion $a$, let $J_a\dashv P_a$ be exact termwise extension by zero, with open unit the identity on sections over the open [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Direct-image compositors are mates of inverse-image compositors [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting].

Let $Q$ be a commutative square of schemes with top arrow $k:U\hookrightarrow V$, bottom arrow $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ quasi-compact open, vertical arrows $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$ proper, and $pk=ir$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Set $V_W=V\times_ZW$ with projections $b:V_W\to V$, $q:V_W\to W$, and $s=(k,r):U\to V_W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $s$ is clopen. Let $\pi_s:M\to J_sP_sM$ be projection to the component $s(U)$, identity there and zero on its complementary open. Put
$$\alpha_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta_{i,p}}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\pi_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\cong J_kP_r,$$
where $\beta$ is the open-unit-normalized map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and define its proper mate
$$\Gamma_Q=(S_pJ_k\varepsilon_r)\circ(S_p\alpha_QS_r)\circ(\eta_pJ_iS_r):J_iS_r\to S_pJ_k.$$
There is a canonical isomorphism
$$\lambda_Q:P_iS_pJ_k\cong S_qP_bJ_k\cong S_qJ_s\cong S_qS_s\cong S_r.$$
The first isomorphism is right-adjoint conjugation of the cartesian open comparison $P_pJ_i\cong J_bP_q$; the middle identification $J_s=S_s$ is the clopen section formula. The map $\Gamma_Q$ is the $J_i\dashv P_i$ adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$, and $\lambda_Q\circ P_i\Gamma_Q=1$ under the open unit.

For vertical pasting $Q_1$ above $Q_2$ with vertical maps $r_1,r_2$ on the left and $p_1,p_2$ on the right, and for horizontal pasting $Q_1$ left of $Q_2$ with top opens $k,l$, bottom opens $i,j$ and verticals $r,p,q$, respectively,
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(S_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_{r_1}),\qquad
\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_k)\circ(J_j\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
For base change $h:Z_1\to Z$, write $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ for the projections, and $Q_1$ for the induced square. Let $E_p:P_hS_p\to S_{p_1}P_a$ and $E_r:P_cS_r\to S_{r_1}P_d$ be the canonical pullback-square mates. Then
$$(S_{p_1}\beta_{k,a})\circ(E_pJ_k)\circ(P_h\Gamma_Q)
=(\Gamma_{Q_1}P_d)\circ(J_{i_1}E_r)\circ(\beta_{i,h}S_r).$$
All equations use the canonical compositors, hold in the semilinear derived categories before evaluation, and are independent of parenthesization. Identity verticals or identity horizontals give identity transformations. They apply also to noncartesian refinement squares, where $r=1$ and $s$ is the clopen section.

If a commutative ring $B$ has compatible maps $B\to C_n$, termwise restriction to constant-$B$ module towers identifies $\Gamma_Q$ with the normalized constant-tower mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], via the canonical scalar-restriction direct-image and pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Evaluation gives the same mate over $C_n$. When $C_n$ is finite and the evaluated input has a bounded-below etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], it is the specified finite proper/open comparison. No faithfulness of derived evaluation or scalar restriction on morphisms is asserted.

proof.text: Use [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting] on the given inverse ring sequence; its system category and simultaneous section models are those of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] used in the statement. It constructs the clopen lift, intrinsic $\alpha_Q$ and its proper mate on the system category. Its $\beta^{-1}$ is the open-adjunction transpose of inverse-image composition after the open unit, which is the inverse formula of $\beta$ in [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization] for ring systems; so its $\alpha_Q$ and $\gamma_Q$ are the stated $\alpha_Q$ and $\Gamma_Q$. No levelwise choice is involved.

Form $\lambda_Q$ by conjugating cartesian $\beta$, cancelling the open unit, identifying $J_s\cong S_s$, and composing $S_qS_s\cong S_r$. Apply [lem-sf-adjunct-conjugate-open-factor] to $\alpha_Q$, with $f=\pi_sP_q$ followed by $J_sP_sP_q\varepsilon_r$, using $P_sP_q\cong P_r$. Expanding alpha and cancelling beta inverse proves the transport hypothesis of that lemma by naturality of the open compositor. The clopen unit formula turns its adjunct into the composite-adjunction unit followed by counit. The triangle identity makes it the inverse of the $S_qS_s\cong S_r$ compositor. Thus the open adjunct is $\lambda_Q^{-1}$; multiplying by $\lambda_Q$ gives the asserted restriction identity.

The intrinsic alpha pasting and identity clauses of [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting] give the displayed vertical and horizontal mate equations, including refinement squares. Their compositors are the specified ones.

Take proper-adjunction mates of the two equal alpha words of [lem-sf-semilinear-alpha-pullback]. The generic exchange-mate cube and mate pasting identify their transposes with the two displayed words containing $E_p,E_r$ and the endpoint beta maps. This proves the base-change equation intrinsically.

Use [lem-sf-semilinear-scalar-ordinary-comparison] to construct the exact sectionwise restriction $\rho^0$ and its unit-preserving ordinary comparisons, including preservation of $\alpha_Q$. For $\rho=D(\rho^0)$, [lem-sf-semilinear-scalar-derived-comparison] supplies their localized comparisons and invertible direct-image mates. Paste the preserved alpha square with the $p$ and $r$ scalar squares and take mates. Mate pasting identifies $\rho\Gamma_Q$ with the constant-$B$ mate through these specified comparisons.

Evaluation of the varying-ring mate is the constant-$C_n$ mate by [lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting]. For finite $C_n$ apply the finite etale-origin clause of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus] to the constant tower on the evaluated input. This is the specified finite comparison. The witness is bounded below exactly as required there.

The normalized compositor coherence of [lem-sf-semilinear-compositor-coherence] removes every parenthesization ambiguity in these equations. Repeated binary reassociation reduces a finite pasting to a fixed bracketing; each move preserves the mate by step 3.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q49-2acd3e0bf (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, all 6 new nodes and the statement of every cited node. The 2026-10-21 re-split note is met: the item statement is byte-identical to live; the proof went from 11946 characters in 6 steps to 2590 in 7 steps; the 6 new nodes are statement-only and of comparable size (1057 to 1672 characters). Every old argument now has its own node. Old step 2 (lambda_Q) is split between adjunct-conjugate-open-factor and clopen-unit-projector. Old step 4 becomes alpha-pullback plus the existing exchange-mate cube. Old step 5 becomes the ordinary and derived scalar-comparison nodes, with steps 5 and 6 of the item. Old step 6 becomes compositor-coherence. None of the new nodes restates the item or one of its clauses. All 6 new statements are true; I checked them by hand. For adjunct-conjugate-open-factor I checked every type and proved it: by the composite-adjunction conjugate, c applied to adj(gamma) equals adj(h composed with beta inverse), and R_q(z) cancels the rest. For alpha-pullback I checked the types and that the clopen decomposition and pi_s pull back (0F7F). For clopen-unit-projector, t_s is invertible for a clopen s (03DI), the identity (t_s P_s) pi_s = eta_s matches the definition of pi_s, and P_c pi_s = 0. For the scalar comparisons, f^{-1} of a constant sheaf is constant, d0 is the identity on sections, and d_f is an isomorphism because evaluations detect isomorphisms. Compositor coherence follows from fibre-product associativity. There are no duplicates: lem-cbc-clopen-extension-zero-comparison covers constant Lambda on étale sites only, def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons is a definition for A_n, and lem-sf-ambient-proper-open-pasting has associativity only for A_n. There is no cycle. Steps 2 to 7 check out, including the conjugate direction in step 2 and the use of the mate cube for E_p and E_r in step 4. Two repairable faults, fixed in fixes/. (1) C4: step 1 claimed lem-sp gives exactly the stated formulas without citing lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization and lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, which identify its beta and its section models with the statement's; the base step cited both. I added both, with the formula (beta inverse is the open transpose of inverse-image composition after the open unit), and updated proof_deps; the proof is now 2954 characters. (2) B3: five new nodes use proper, quasi-compact open and open immersion without citing def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties; I added it to their stmt_deps. Batch-5 flag: the three citations of def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows are accepted. That definition is already in the item's base closure through lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting. The node it reaches, lem-pod-derived-exact-square-composition, is generic derived-square composition, not a step of the trace formula or of Poincaré duality, and is also in the item's base stmt_deps closure. Comparing the item's closure on the base and on the delivery adds only the 6 new nodes and the generic lem-weil-pbc-exchange-mate-cube. The tool use of lem-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-pasting is accepted (generic construction, already cited by the reviewed base). There is no SGA citation.
